Hello and welcome to issue 412 of The Weekly Digest.

This week our editors collected a long list of articles about productivity systems,
some thoughts on remote work, and a few book recommendations. We also reviewed a
new wave of productivity apps that claim to change how you plan your week.

Our readers wrote in about focus techniques, meeting fatigue, and how to keep a
to-do list from growing without bound. Several of you asked for more interviews
with people who manage large remote teams, so we have included two of those this
week. We have also published a short history of the Pomodoro technique.

If you enjoy this issue, forward it to a colleague who might like it. You are
receiving this email because you subscribed to our weekly roundup. We have been
sending it every Sunday for several years and it remains one of the most widely
read newsletters in the industry.
